name: ToggleLogic
description: Free-tier model routing for OpenClaw: apply static routes, opt-in provider-constrained family aliases, a simple static cheapest-default, and sticky model overrides that hold until you switch back — with structured audit and privacy-safe local fleet cost attribution. Bring your own provider credentials; no benchmark engine or proprietary model registry is included. Optional cost visibility reports per-model dollar estimates from dynamic public pricing (observe-only; unpriced-loud, never a false $0.00). PATENT PENDING. An optional, separately-licensed ToggleLogic Intelligence layer can add benchmark-driven automatic selection. Source-available under the ToggleLogic Free-Tier License (see LICENSE).

mode.description: Routing mode. 'auto' uses the licensed intelligence layer if present, else the cheap default if configured, else passthrough. 'passthrough' defers every selection to OpenClaw's default. 'configured' uses static configuredRoutes matched only against host-supplied task labels, then optional default. 'cheap' applies the deployment-declared cheapest default (a dumb static preference — no registry/benchmark). 'intelligence' requires the separately-licensed intelligence layer and reports unavailable rather than silently downgrading.

enabled.description: Whether ToggleLogic writes its routing decision log.

path.description: Routing decision log path (jsonl, one object per line). Tilde expansion supported.

rotateSizeMb.description: File size in MB at which the log rotates.

configuredRoutes.description: Static task-label-to-model mappings used in 'configured' mode. Labels may be supplied by the host as hookContext.taskType, hookContext.task, hookContext.capability, event.taskType, event.task, or event.metadata.taskType. `default` is optional fallback. Prompt text is never inspected.

cheapHeuristic.description: The simple cheapest-default (free tier). A DUMB, request-agnostic static preference: it never inspects the request, never consults a model registry/benchmark, and embeds no model names or prices. The deployment declares which of ITS models is the cheap default; the plugin just defaults to it (the user teaches real preferences via owner overrides). This is NOT the patented Intelligence selection engine.

default.description: A single model ref to default to (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5').

order.description: Cheapest-first ordered list of model refs the DEPLOYMENT declares; the plugin uses order[0]. The plugin does not compute relative cost — the ordering is the deployment's declaration.

familyResolution.description: Optional family aliases for configuredRoutes only. Disabled by default. Reads the deployment's cached public Models.dev catalog, restricts candidates to explicitly approved providers that are also configured in OpenClaw, and requires complete non-zero pricing. It never changes cheap mode.

catalogPath.description: Deployment-local Models.dev cache. No catalog ships in this package.

intelligence.description: Detection of an OPTIONAL, separately-licensed ToggleLogic Intelligence layer. Not included in this package; absent by default. When present and 'intelligence'/'auto' mode is active, the plugin defers model selection to it.

enabled.description: Whether to attempt to detect a licensed intelligence layer at startup.

path.description: Filesystem path where a licensed intelligence layer would be installed. Tilde expansion supported.

registryPath.description: Optional path to the licensed layer's normalized model registry. Config-driven (deployment DATA); when unset, defaults to a path relative to the layer (<path>/normalized.json). No workspace path is hardcoded. Tilde expansion supported.

shadow.description: When true, evaluate and audit Intelligence decisions but never emit a model override. Use for a versioned canary before enabling live routing.

fallbackOnError.description: If true, errors from the intelligence layer yield no override (OpenClaw falls back to its default selection).

ownerOverride.description: User/owner model override (the pin mechanism). A top-priority sticky model applied ABOVE routing; pins persist across turns until manually cleared.

enabled.description: Whether the routing hook checks for an active owner override before routing.

statePath.description: Path to the owner-override state file (JSON: {active, model_ref, provider_override?, ...}). Written by deployment tooling; read per request by this plugin. The plugin never writes it. Tilde expansion supported.

askConsumer.description: Deployment-supplied consumer script invoked at turn-end when an override is active and the turn is substantive, so the deployment can prompt the owner to switch back. The plugin authors no prompt content. Used only when features.ownerOverrideAsk is enabled.

features.description: Capability feature toggles. Each capability registers its hooks only when enabled.

routing.description: Model routing (before_model_resolve hook). Opt-in; also requires the gateway's plugins.entries.togglelogic.hooks.allowConversationAccess.

enabled.description: Whether to register the routing hook.

ownerOverrideAsk.description: Owner-override switch-back notifier (message_sending). Structurally invokes the deployment-supplied consumer so the owner can be prompted to switch back to the default. Opt-in; default off.

enabled.description: Whether to register the owner-override turn-end notifier.

costVisibility.description: Cost visibility (llm_output observe-only). Reports per-model/per-day DOLLAR cost from dynamic public pricing; unpriced-loud, never $0.00; never enforces. Opt-in; default off. Also requires the gateway's plugins.entries.togglelogic.hooks.allowConversationAccess (llm_output is a conversation hook).

enabled.description: Whether to register the cost-visibility observer.

audit.description: Structured audit log of consequential plugin actions (NIST 800-53 AU-2/AU-3/AU-12 schema bar). JSONL, append-only, rotated by size. Independent of the routing log.

enabled.description: Whether to write the audit log.

path.description: Audit log path. Tilde expansion supported.

rotateSizeMb.description: File size in MB at which the audit log rotates.

costVisibility.description: Cost-visibility settings (used when features.costVisibility.enabled). Observe-only; reports per-model/per-day dollar cost from dynamic public pricing. Never enforces.

attribution.description: Privacy-safe local fleet attribution. Values are non-secret slugs written only to the local cost ledger; ToggleLogic never sends them to Motherboard or any ToggleLogic service.

deploymentId.description: Stable deployment slug, for example sam-andy or sam-cf. When omitted, the local hostname is used.

costCenter.description: Optional non-secret billing cost-center slug. Do not place names, email addresses, account numbers, or credentials here.

log.description: The plugin's own cost log (JSONL, one row per call plus periodic loud summaries). Independent of the routing/audit logs.

enabled.description: Whether to write the cost log.

path.description: Cost log path. Tilde expansion supported.

rotateSizeMb.description: File size in MB at which the cost log rotates.

pricing.description: Dynamic public pricing. Fetched with a browser-like User-Agent, cached locally, refreshed on a slow cadence — never per-call, never from any Motherboard endpoint. Falls back to a bundled LiteLLM snapshot (MIT) when the source is unreachable.

sourceUrl.description: Public pricing source (Models.dev api.json; MIT, USD per million tokens).

cachePath.description: Local cache path for fetched pricing. Tilde expansion supported.

userPriceOverridePath.description: Optional deployment-supplied price map (DATA) taking highest priority. Tilde expansion supported. The plugin never writes it.

summaryEveryCalls.description: Emit a loud day-summary line to the cost log every N observed calls.
